title: Cloud Network Entity
description: Common cloud network/VPC properties. Parent for provider-specific network sub-types.

cidr.description: Primary CIDR block for the network (e.g., 10.0.0.0/16).

public.description: Whether the subnet has public internet access.

enable_dns.description: Whether to enable DNS resolution in the network.

enable_nat.description: Whether to enable NAT for private subnets.
